# Greyling

Internal ID: Greyling | Faction: Forest | Main biome: Meadows | Drops: Resin | Abilities: Attack (2s) | Very weak to (x2): Fire | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Stagger | Resistant to (x0.5): Poison | Immune to (x0): Spirit, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe | Stagger limit: 30%

# Introduction

Greylings are aggressive creatures found in Meadows. They are mossy tree-like beings and are substantially weaker than their Greydwarf counterparts.

### Drops

• Item: Resin | 0 Star: 1

### Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in forests of Meadows | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Common | Stars: No

• Type: During "The forest is moving..." event before defeating The Elder | Limit: 4 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

### Attack

Swings their hand sideways in a 1.5-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (5 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

## Notes

• Along with Necks and Boars, Greylings are one of the first enemies the player may encounter in Valheim.
• 1-star and 2-star Greylings can only be spawned in using commands, and take on the appearance of the 1-star and 2-star Greydwarfs.
